name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 26, 2013
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Sheri Rowe, President, The Vista Republican Women Federated
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring the month of April 2013, "Fair Housing Month" in the City of Vista
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/SA/BSD)
C3.
League of California Cities Proposed Bylaws Amendments (CC)
C4.
Fiscal Year 2013/14 Sewer Capacity Fee Charges (CC/BSD)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , memorializing the FY 2013/14 sewer capacity charges in accordance with City Ordinance No. 2006-6; and
2.
Adopt Buena Sanitation District Board Resolution No. 2013- , memorializing the FY 2013/14 sewer capacity charges in accordance with Buena Sanitation District Board Ordinance No. 2006-2.
C5.
Engineer's Reports for Fiscal Year 2013/14 Levy of Assessments (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , ordering the City Engineer to prepare a report of the assessments to be levied for the maintenance of improvements of City of Vista Landscaping and Lighting District No. 1;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , ordering the City Engineer to prepare a report of the assessments to be levied for the maintenance of improvements of City of Vista Street Maintenance District No. 1; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , ordering the City Engineer to prepare a report of the assessments to be levied for the maintenance of improvements of the South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District.
C6.
Mobile Radio Purchase (CC)
C7.
Changes to Crime and Substance Abuse Prevention Commission (CC)
C8.
FTA Section 5310 Grant Funds from the California Department of Transportation (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a public hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed levy of assessments on businesses within the Central Vista Business Improvement District, and if insufficient written protests are received;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , confirming the 2013/14 annual report for the Central Vista Business Improvement District and levying the assessment for the 2013/14 fiscal year.
PH2.
2013-2014 Community Development Block Grant Annual Action Plan and Revised 2012-2013 Annual Action Plan (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a public hearing to accept comments on the proposed 2013-2014 Annual Action Plan and the revised 2012-2013 Annual Action Plan; and
2.
Open the 30 day public review period for the proposed 2013-2014 Annual Action Plan and the revised 2012-2013 Annual Action Plan.
PH3.
2012 Regional Transportation Improvement Plan Amendment (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a public hearing to receive testimony on the City of Vista's list of transportation projects eligible to use transportation sales tax (TransNet) funds; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2013- , adopting an amendment to the TransNet Local Street Improvement Program of Projects for Fiscal Years 2013 through 2017.
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fiscal Year 2013/14 Budget Overview (CC/CDC/BSD)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
